rules.name: docs
rules.reason: docs fail by lying; reviewer checks claims against code

rules.name: tests-only
rules.reason: test additions are cheap to verify by running them

rules.name: test-weakening
rules.reason: deleted or skipped tests are the classic agent cheating signal

rules.name: feature-flags
rules.reason: config fails by misrouting; flag flips reach prod without a deploy

rules.name: replication-config
rules.reason: replication and timing knobs change safety and liveness, not just behaviour

rules.name: migration
rules.reason: schema change: check backfill, lock behaviour and the rollback path

rules.name: migration-destructive
rules.reason: destructive or lock-taking migration; irreversible or blocks writes

rules.name: consensus
rules.reason: consensus code: bugs show up as split brain or lost writes, rarely in CI

rules.name: durability-calls
rules.reason: touches an fsync path anywhere in the tree

rules.name: idempotency
rules.reason: idempotency handling: a bug here double-posts money

rules.name: ci-workflows
rules.reason: CI is the verifier; an agent must not edit its own grader unreviewed

rules.name: agent-instructions
rules.reason: changes what the agents and the reviewer are told

rules.name: dependencies
rules.reason: supply chain; check licence and transitive changes
